motion_limits.mode: Design/calibration contract only, not executable motor control
motion_limits.manufacturer_mechanical_stop: No limit: no physical servo end stop to rely on
motion_limits.qualification: Require real plate/gear phase calibration and gentle contact teaching with limited force/current; do not blindly drive to these absolute ticks or command negative jaw angles. Encoder quantization, gearbox backlash and resin compliance mean nominal CAD contact is not physical fit approval.

tolerances.compliance: No stiffness/contact-force model or qualified flexure. Nominal rigid contact faces need physical tolerance/force-limited calibration; never close farther to hide error.

qualification: Actual CAD tips contact at jaw0 on integral1.5mm distal faces; 20mm pivots keep rear clearance. Whole-hand and physical hardware-fit/strength acceptance are separate and unverified.
